title: docs: size the version check input to its content
body: ~~Replace `width: 100px` with `field-sizing: content`.~~ Use `field-sizing: content` if supported. For unsupported browsers, keep the current behaviour. | Before | After | | :---: | :---: | | | | ~~Note that `field-sizing: content` only reach baseline on June 2026 ([caniuse](https://caniuse.com/wf-field-sizing)), and i didn't find any Browserslist config or documented minimum-browser-support policy for the docs site. On unsupported browsers, this falls back to the default fixed-size input behavior.~~ Closes #23504
